versions.changelog:
- Removed the skill-card.md file from the project.
- No changes to features, commands, or core logic in this version.
- Documentation and safety guidelines remain unchanged.

**Adds safety guidance and clarifies risk for remote device control.**

- Added a prominent Safety Notice section detailing risks, user consent requirements, and best practices for safe use.
- Updated tool reference table to highlight which actions may modify device state.
- Adjusted naming from "mobile-agent" to "phone-agent" in user configuration instructions.
- Removed the sample skill-card.md file.
- Improved wording and readability throughout the documentation for clarity.

- Skill renamed from "phone-agent" to "mobile-agent" throughout documentation and configuration examples.
- All references, setup commands, and sample config entries updated to use "mobile-agent".
- No changes to code or functionality; updates are documentation-only.

Initial release of phone-agent skill, enabling remote control of real phones from OpenClaw via a local MCP relay.

- Allows OpenClaw to operate Android/iPhone devices (open apps, tap, input text, take screenshots, etc.) by describing the task in natural language.
- Provides tools to run AI automation tasks, capture screenshots, query device info, manage and abort ongoing phone tasks.
- Connects via a local Node.js MCP server and communicates with a Mobile AI Agent running in the browser.
- Includes setup instructions and troubleshooting guidance.
- Configurable WebSocket relay port (`PHONE_AGENT_WS_PORT`, defaults to 7788).
